```{r US city data, eval=FALSE}
data <- st_read("C:/Users/T14/7Programming/R/class/geospatial/projects/project01/data/2020_us_urb_area/US_urb_area_2020.shp")

sf.uscities <- data %>% 
  select(NAME20, INTPTLON20, INTPTLAT20, geometry)
head(sf.uscities)

dim(sf.uscities)

sf.usa <- world %>% 
  filter(name_long == "United States")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data=sf.usa) +
  geom_sf(data=sf.uscities) +
  theme_void()
```

```{r MX NL data}
r.nlights <- rast("data/nightlights/NL.tif")
# load mexico boundary - can get from INEGI or rnaturalearth
mex <- geodata::gadm("MEX", level = 0, path = "data/")  # or use st_read() if you have a shapefile

# crop and mask
r.mex <- crop(r.nlights, mex)        # crop to bounding box first (fast)
r.mex <- mask(r.mex, mex) 

writeRaster(r.mex, 'data/nightlights/NL_mexico.tif', overwrite = TRUE)
r.mxlog <- log1p(r.mex)  # log1p handles zeros gracefully (log(1+x))
plot(r.mxlog)
```
